lines.zh: 我立着身子，用背鳍慢慢划水。
lines.en: I drift upright, rowing with my little back fin.

lines.zh: 尾巴卷住海草，我被水流推得摇。
lines.en: My tail grips the seagrass while the current shoves me.

lines.zh: 珊瑚枝间空隙太窄，我侧身挤过去。
lines.en: The coral gap is narrow, so I squeeze through sideways.

lines.zh: 我一寸一寸往上漂，像根会动的草。
lines.en: I rise inch by inch, a moving blade of grass.

lines.zh: 肚子贴过沙面，扬起一小团白雾。
lines.en: My belly brushes sand and kicks up a small white cloud.

lines.zh: 我靠着礁石背面走，那里水流最缓。
lines.en: I travel on the reef's lee side, where the current is softest.

lines.zh: 小鳍拍得太快，我自己都听不清。
lines.en: My fins beat so fast I cannot hear my own buzzing.

lines.zh: 我从海草丛这头挪到那头，用了很久。
lines.en: Crossing the seagrass bed takes me a long while.

lines.zh: 有影子过去，我立刻停住不动。
lines.en: A shadow passes; I stop dead and hold still.

lines.zh: 我顺着暖水往上，珊瑚顶更亮。
lines.en: I ride the warm water up toward the brighter coral top.

lines.zh: 我卷着尾巴倒退，比前进还稳。
lines.en: I reverse with my tail curled, steadier than going forward.

lines.zh: 浪一推，我翻了半圈又立回来。
lines.en: A wave tips me half over; I right myself again.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙地滑，尽量不碰珊瑚。
lines.en: I skim the sand, trying not to touch the coral.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到礁缝里，那里没人挤。
lines.en: I ease into a reef crevice where nobody crowds me.

lines.zh: 我找到一个礁洞，先钻进去。
lines.en: I find a hole in the reef and slip inside.

lines.zh: 我松开尾巴，让浪推我过礁。
lines.en: I let go of my hold and let the swell carry me.

lines.zh: 我竖着往下沉，落在软沙上。
lines.en: I sink upright and settle on soft sand.

lines.zh: 前面是开阔的水，我退了回来。
lines.en: Open water ahead, so I back away.

lines.zh: 我含着海水，鳃一张一合。
lines.en: I hold seawater and let my gills open and close.

lines.zh: 我把自己挂在一株海草上打盹。
lines.en: I hook myself to a blade of seagrass and doze.

lines.zh: 我数着水里的光点，数到七就乱了。
lines.en: I count the flecks of light and lose track at seven.

lines.zh: 珊瑚虫伸出触手，我盯着看很久。
lines.en: Coral polyps reach out their tentacles; I watch a long time.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个小气泡，看它升上去。
lines.en: I blow a tiny bubble and watch it climb.

lines.zh: 水里很静，只有我尾巴在轻轻摆。
lines.en: The water is quiet except my tail's small sway.

lines.zh: 我想起自己只有两点血，就缩了缩。
lines.en: I recall I have only two hearts, and shrink smaller.

lines.zh: 我贴紧礁石，等危险自己走开。
lines.en: I press to the rock and wait for danger to leave.

lines.zh: 海草划过我的背，痒得我抖了一下。
lines.en: Seagrass brushes my back and makes me twitch.

lines.zh: 我张口接住漂过的碎屑，味道一般。
lines.en: I catch drifting scraps in my mouth; they taste plain.

lines.zh: 远处有大鱼翻身，我立刻沉下去。
lines.en: A big fish rolls far off; I sink at once.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍收起来，尽量像一块石头。
lines.en: I fold my back fin in and pretend to be stone.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转圈，找一个看不见我的角度。
lines.en: I turn slowly, hunting an angle where I am unseen.

lines.zh: 我在礁缝里打了个小哈欠，水灌进来。
lines.en: I yawn in my crevice and swallow a mouth of water.

lines.zh: 你这么大，为什么一直盯着我。
lines.en: You are huge; why do you keep staring at me?

lines.zh: 我只有两滴血，碰一下就没了。
lines.en: I have two hearts; one touch and I am gone.

lines.zh: 你的手别伸过来，我会当成大鱼。
lines.en: Keep your hand back; I will take it for a big fish.

lines.zh: 我立在水里看你，脖子有点酸。
lines.en: I stand upright to watch you, and my neck aches.

lines.zh: 你穿的东西在水里会吸水吗。
lines.en: Does what you wear soak up water down here?

lines.zh: 我认得你的眼睛，刚才也在这片礁。
lines.en: I know your eyes; they were on this reef before.

lines.zh: 你要是想吃我，一口就够了。
lines.en: If you mean to eat me, one bite is enough.

lines.zh: 我卷着海草看你，这样比较安心。
lines.en: I watch you holding seagrass; it makes me feel safer.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住珊瑚，光都暗了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the coral and dims the light.

lines.zh: 我不逃，反正我游不过你。
lines.en: I will not flee; I cannot outswim you anyway.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，肚皮朝天。
lines.en: I flip over, belly to the sky.

lines.zh: 就一下，我快没气了。
lines.en: One hit and I am nearly out of air.

lines.zh: 我的鳍破了一角，游起来歪。
lines.en: A corner of my fin is torn; I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我慌了。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water and I panic.

lines.zh: 我缩进珊瑚缝，抖个不停。
lines.en: I squeeze into the coral and tremble.

lines.zh: 我听见自己在喘，声音很小。
lines.en: I hear myself panting, very faintly.

lines.zh: 这伤对我来说太重了。
lines.en: This wound is far too heavy for me.

lines.zh: 我卷紧尾巴，怕自己漂走。
lines.en: I clench my tail, afraid I will drift away.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我身上疼。
lines.en: Do not touch me; my body hurts.

lines.zh: 我还没死，还能再游一段。
lines.en: I am not dead; I can still swim a while.

lines.zh: 你指缝里有小虾碎，我闻到了。
lines.en: There are shrimp bits between your fingers; I smell them.

lines.zh: 我把嘴凑近，又缩回去。
lines.en: I bring my snout close, then pull it back.

lines.zh: 那点吃的太小，我嘴也小。
lines.en: The morsel is tiny, and so is my mouth.

lines.zh: 我卷住海草，探出半个头看。
lines.en: I coil on seagrass and poke half my head out.

lines.zh: 你要真给我，就放在珊瑚上。
lines.en: If you truly offer it, set it on the coral.

lines.zh: 我慢慢漂过去，鳍抖得厉害。
lines.en: I drift over slowly, my fins trembling badly.

lines.zh: 这点香味比整片海草都勾人。
lines.en: That smell pulls harder than the whole seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 我张嘴吸一口，什么都没吸到。
lines.en: I open my mouth and suck in nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我饿，可我更怕你的手。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I fear your hand more.

lines.zh: 你再放低一点，我就敢过来。
lines.en: Lower it a little more and I will dare come closer.

lines.zh: 你撞得我转了半圈，我头晕。
lines.en: You knocked me half around; my head is spinning.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你走路都不看下面。
lines.en: I am this small; you never look down when you walk.

lines.zh: 我的鳍被挤歪了，缓一缓。
lines.en: My fin got bent; give me a moment.

lines.zh: 你一脚带起沙，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Your step stirs sand and I cannot see a thing.

lines.zh: 别用膝盖蹭礁石，我在那儿。
lines.en: Do not rub your knee on the reef; I am there.

lines.zh: 我被撞进珊瑚缝，卡住了。
lines.en: I got knocked into a coral crack and stuck.

lines.zh: 你身上掉下来的东西砸到我尾巴。
lines.en: Something fell off you and hit my tail.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，经不起再撞。
lines.en: I have two hearts; I cannot take another bump.

lines.zh: 退后一点，我的海草被你踩平了。
lines.en: Step back; you flattened my seagrass.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边漂，你差点没看见。
lines.en: I drifted by your feet and you nearly missed me.

lines.zh: 我卷着你的尾巴，慢慢转一圈。
lines.en: I curl my tail around yours and turn once slowly.

lines.zh: 这片海草够软，就在这儿吧。
lines.en: This seagrass is soft enough; let us stay here.

lines.zh: 我们俩加起来也只有四点血。
lines.en: Between us we have only four hearts.

lines.zh: 你别游太快，我跟不上你的鳍。
lines.en: Do not swim fast; I cannot match your fins.

lines.zh: 珊瑚后面没人看，我们靠紧些。
lines.en: Nobody watches behind the coral; come closer.

lines.zh: 我尾巴缠上你，就不想松开。
lines.en: My tail is wrapped around yours and I will not let go.

lines.zh: 我们说好一起守着这丛海草。
lines.en: We agree to guard this clump of seagrass together.

lines.zh: 你身上的纹路和我很像。
lines.en: The pattern on you looks much like mine.

lines.zh: 浪来了，我们一起弯下身子。
lines.en: A wave comes; we both bend with it.

lines.zh: 有你在，我这两点血也不怕了。
lines.en: With you here, my two hearts do not feel so thin.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起一片海草，又掉了。
lines.en: I take a seagrass leaf in my snout and drop it.

lines.zh: 我尾巴卷不住这块东西，太滑。
lines.en: My tail cannot hold this; it is too slippery.

lines.zh: 我试着推它，它比我还大。
lines.en: I try to push it, but it is bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我把它顶在鼻尖上，走两步就翻。
lines.en: I balance it on my snout and tip over in two steps.

lines.zh: 这东西沉，我拉不动。
lines.en: This thing is heavy; I cannot drag it.

lines.zh: 我叼着小石子，当成宝贝藏着。
lines.en: I carry a pebble in my mouth like a treasure.

lines.zh: 你要的话，我还给你。
lines.en: If you want it, I will give it back.

lines.zh: 我用鳍抱住它，抱得很勉强。
lines.en: I hug it with my fins, and barely manage.

lines.zh: 它卡在珊瑚上，我叼不下来。
lines.en: It is stuck in the coral; I cannot pull it loose.

lines.zh: 我放下就走，反正也不缺这个。
lines.en: I put it down and leave; I do not need it.

lines.zh: 我盯住那片晃动的海草，有东西。
lines.en: I fix on the swaying seagrass; something is in there.

lines.zh: 那边有条影子，我先躲。
lines.en: There is a shadow over there; I hide first.

lines.zh: 我把背鳍竖起，假装自己很硬。
lines.en: I raise my back fin and pretend to be tough.

lines.zh: 我锁定一小团孑孓，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I lock onto a small swarm of larvae and creep close.

lines.zh: 我不追大的，只敢看小的。
lines.en: I do not chase big things; only small ones.

lines.zh: 有东西咬海草，我转头去瞧。
lines.en: Something bites the seagrass; I turn to look.

lines.zh: 我认出那对大颚，是捕食我的。
lines.en: I know those big jaws; they hunt me.

lines.zh: 我盯它盯得太久，忘了自己在哪。
lines.en: I stare so long I forget where I am.

lines.zh: 这条缝是我的，我守着。
lines.en: This crack is mine, and I am guarding it.

lines.zh: 我瞄准漂过的小虫，尾巴绷紧。
lines.en: I aim at a drifting bug, tail pulled tight.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，找最薄的一侧。
lines.en: I circle it, looking for its thinnest side.

lines.zh: 我的嘴太小，咬不动它。
lines.en: My mouth is too small to bite it.

lines.zh: 我卷住海草，等它靠近。
lines.en: I coil around the seagrass and wait for it to come near.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石靠近，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I hug the rock and close in as quietly as I can.

lines.zh: 我在等它离海草远一点。
lines.en: I wait for it to drift away from the seagrass.

lines.zh: 它比我想的大，我犹豫了。
lines.en: It is bigger than I thought; I hesitate.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，只留眼睛在外。
lines.en: I lower my body and leave only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 这口气我憋不了多久。
lines.en: I cannot hold this breath much longer.

lines.zh: 我数到三就冲，结果没冲。
lines.en: I count to three and charge, then do not.

lines.zh: 我又盯上它了，改不了这毛病。
lines.en: I am fixed on it again; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子顶它一下，自己弹开。
lines.en: I butt it with my snout and bounce off myself.

lines.zh: 我甩尾巴打它，声音比力气大。
lines.en: I slap it with my tail; the sound beats the force.

lines.zh: 这一下用光了我全部力气。
lines.en: That one hit used all the strength I have.

lines.zh: 它没退，我倒是退了三步。
lines.en: It did not budge; I backed off three steps.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，牙都酸了。
lines.en: I bite its fin and my jaw aches.

lines.zh: 我撞进它怀里，被弹回礁石。
lines.en: I ram its chest and get bounced into the reef.

lines.zh: 别笑，我这两点血也敢打。
lines.en: Do not laugh; even with two hearts I fight.

lines.zh: 我卷住它的尾巴往后拽。
lines.en: I coil around its tail and haul backward.

lines.zh: 我打在壳上，鼻子发麻。
lines.en: I strike shell and my snout goes numb.

lines.zh: 它一甩，我飞出去老远。
lines.en: One flick of its body throws me far.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚缝里醒过来，水是温的。
lines.en: I wake in a coral crack; the water is warm.

lines.zh: 海草丛里挤着两只，我是其中之一。
lines.en: Two of us crowd the seagrass; I am one.

lines.zh: 我刚出生就会卷尾巴了。
lines.en: I could curl my tail the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 这株珊瑚比我高很多。
lines.en: This coral stands far taller than I do.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼就听见水流的声音。
lines.en: I open my eyes to the sound of moving water.

lines.zh: 身边还有一只，我们互相看了看。
lines.en: Another one is beside me; we look at each other.

lines.zh: 我摆了两下鳍，确认自己会游。
lines.en: I beat my fins twice to confirm I can swim.

lines.zh: 沙地上有我的影子，很小一团。
lines.en: My shadow on the sand is a tiny blob.

lines.zh: 我是被什么放到这里的，不记得了。
lines.en: Something put me here; I do not remember what.

lines.zh: 礁石的味道有点咸，我记住了。
lines.en: The reef tastes of salt, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 水一下变烫，我的鳞片卷起来。
lines.en: The water turns hot and my plates curl.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下来，撞在沙上。
lines.en: I fall from the surface and hit the sand.

lines.zh: 我离开水，鳃粘在一起。
lines.en: Out of water, my gills stick together.

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我被推得打转。
lines.en: The blast tears the water and spins me around.

lines.zh: 一支尖物穿过我的鳍。
lines.en: A sharp thing passes through my fin.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进我的小骨头。
lines.en: A cold force seeps into my little bones.

lines.zh: 我饿得连沙都想去吸。
lines.en: I am so hungry I would suck at sand.

lines.zh: 白光穿过海水，我全身发麻。
lines.en: White light cuts the water; my whole body tingles.

lines.zh: 尾巴卷不住了，一路下坠。
lines.en: My tail cannot hold. I keep falling.
